snippet.title: Gladiator Command | Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
Build your ludus. Train your gladiators. Conquer the arena.

Gladiator Command is available now in Early Access on Steam

Gladiator Command is a gladiator management and combat simulation where you recruit, train and equip fighters, develop your school, compete against rival ludus owners, and fight your way through increasingly brutal arenas.

Recruit and develop unique gladiators
Build and manage your ludus
Compete in leagues and tournaments
Watch your gladiators fight, survive and die
Experiment with different classes, equipment and strategies
Rise from a small gladiator school to dominate Rome

Wishlist, follow, or join the community to keep up with development.
